text: Objective Strengthen Chinese training and help foreign students to study for Bachelor Degree Main Courses The course mainly focus on language skills including listening, speaking, reading and writing and 26 classes a week a guarantee for good learning. The course also has elective courses, 6 classes a week including mathematics, physics, English, economics, biology and chemistry, which are the basic courses in the undergraduate program. Course Arrangement The courses will be given from Monday to Friday, about 24-26 class hours per week. The duration is 15 weeks, and main courses are Chinese and English training, Physics/chemistry and other basic courses.
